product_one_liner.value: Design Arena lets people create websites, apps, images, videos and other content with AI models, compare their outputs, and contribute to crowdsourced model evaluations.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the homepage navigation or footer; the pricing route returned only a redirect, with no plans or pricing content.

named_customers.notes: The G2 listing has zero reviews and identifies no customer organizations; participating model providers were not counted as customers.

employee_band.notes: Based on Tracxn's reported employee count of 12. The YC profile separately lists a team size of 3, so public sources differ.

eng_blog.notes: Multiple technical posts explain the AgentRunner harness and HTML-to-PowerPoint implementation, but engineer authorship could not be verified.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes an introduction, quickstart, API overview, models, arenas and leaderboard endpoints.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live Member of Technical Staff, ML Engineer posting at Intelligence, the company behind Design Arena.

model_provider.value: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, Mistral and Kimi
model_provider.notes: The company's AgentRunner technical post explicitly names these supported LLM providers.

compliance_certs.notes: No company-held certification was established. SOC 2 and ISO 27001 are attributed only to hosting providers; the privacy policy discusses GDPR legal bases rather than claiming certification.

last_funding.notes: Intelligence, the company behind Design Arena, announced the round led by Index Ventures.

raised_18mo.notes: The $7.9 million seed round announced in August 2026 falls within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official careers board lists technical roles and an open application, but no SDR, BDR or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Introduced Audio Realism Bench on August 4, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The YC profile identifies the CEO and CTO but does not provide leadership start dates or a complete current leadership history; no dated qualifying appointment or departure was verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: No CRM or sales/marketing system was named in the readable job posting and documentation reviewed.
